title: Simons: 'if you knew how he actually made money'
summary: Eric Weinstein tells of Simons: 'if you knew how he actually made money', about unspecified at meeting with Jim Simons, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: He took a drag on his cigarette. There's a very long pause. He said, "Eric, if you knew how he actually made money, you'd be so disappointed."
But I think he had a conversation with Jim Simons once who was like, you know, you'd be disappointed if you knew how we made our money.
tellings.difference: Told second hand by Michels rather than first hand by Weinstein, and without the cigarette detail.
tellings.link_reason: The same remark from Simons to Weinstein that he'd be disappointed if he knew how the money was made.

as_told.title: Jim Simons tells Weinstein 'you'd be disappointed'
